glyph_origin: Jiajie (假借 phonetic loan): The oracle-bone form depicts a lidded 同 (“tube; cylindrical vessel”). Some forms contain strokes inside the vessel, probably representing its contents. In Western Zhou bronze inscriptions, the 同 element changed into 用. One proposal identifies this graph as the original character of 醓 (“meat sauce; minced meat preserved in brine”). 南 may be related to 腩 and 納 (“to put in; to receive”).
